Hackers pull off $133 million French bank heist via service provider
Crédit Mutuel Arkéa was targeted in a cyberattack that enabled fraudulent transactions of up to $133 million, forcing it to respond by suspending certain systems. Crédit Mutuel Arkéa is a major French banking group with more than 5.8 million members and 211.5 billion euros in assets. Reports about the incident emerged on November 2. According to the investigator, the attacker may have stolen up to 118 million euros ($133 million).
